answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can attest or earn, and its weight grows only with a long history of verified work, like a violet thread slowly woven through a canyon of past transactions. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and any identity caught attesting falsely loses its deposit, so a sybil swarm pays far more than it can earn.
